title: Alek Deng [LORA/Krea 2]
description:
Alek Deng grew up in Ottawa, the daughter of a South Sudanese father and an African-Canadian mother. Patient, warm, and armed with a very dry sense of humor, Alek genuinely loves animals while having absolutely no illusions about how ridiculous they can be. She has a particular weakness for the elderly, awkward, three-legged, one-eyed, and generally unwanted cases. Alek insists she only fosters animals temporarily. Her steadily increasing number of pets suggests otherwise.
